about_the_game:
Rockin' Hell is a rhythm-based Metroidvania where you play as Victoria Riot, a rising rock star who, just before playing at the biggest concert in her career, dies and wakes up at the gates of the underworld.

She must descend to the deepest depths of hell and defeat all the different threats to face Death and earn a second chance at life.

Experience an adventure full of action and nostalgia to the rhythm of rock.

Enjoy the soundtrack inspired by 2000s rock, subgenres such as emo, punk, nu metal and heavy metal, our main sound and aesthetic inspirations.

Prove that you were born to be a rockstar using your different instruments as weapons to fight for your life:

  • Bass Guitar: shoot powerful notes and deal damage from a distance using the different effects pedals that will give you different power and sound.

  • Guitar: perform heavy strikes at the rythm of the music fighting at close range.

  • Drum Sticks: strike the enemies with quick hits that will give you a better mobility.

  • Microphone: Take advantage of the cable's elasticity to hook enemies, swing across ceilings, and hit them all with the microphone.

All of them have sound effects that will complement the background music. The better you follow the rythm, the more powerful your attacks will be.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (4th gen) or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card compatible with DirectX
  • Additional Notes: Requires keyboard and mouse or XInput-compatible controller
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 or AMD equivalent
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Dedicated sound card (optional)
  • Additional Notes: Headphones recommended for best audio experience

short_description: Rockin' Hell is a rhythmic metroidvania where you play as Victoria, a rock star who must fight her way through Hell using musical weapons. Time your attacks to the beat, explore infernal realms, defeat bosses, and earn a second chance at life.
supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain*, Spanish - Latin America*
